limitations: Reference children/favourite/recent tag tabs, interactive OR construction and existing-predicate editor/context menu are absent.

additions.label: Input system predicate editors
additions.assessment: Opened from a blank system autocomplete suggestion, the canonical input-predicate window has nineteen groups, multi-page time/URL/similarity editors, typed field validation and preset buttons. OK/presets add real predicates via SearchPage and persist recent predicates; current-predicate re-editing and custom defaults are separate absent workflows.

evidence.description: Checks each recorded group/page/button/panel and its default widgets.
Checks more than 150 recorded individual changes; skips absent tag-advanced autocomplete and explicitly handles TB rendering difference.
Exercises preset and OK insertion, time tab switching, invalid date staying open and Cancel adding nothing.
Blank suggestion opens this window; chosen closure adds its predicates to the live SearchPage.

limitations: Date/time inputs are text rather than a calendar/time picker.
Reference radio/rating widgets become dropdowns; narrow rows scroll rather than wrap.
Viewing times truncate to seconds, forced hash cleanup skips its confirmation, and bitmap clipboard paste is absent.
Custom default system predicate controls and editing an existing predicate are not implemented.
